title: Fort co-op voice: vox-mp.bin +84 entries, modules.bin, 83 speech streams (u3fix.exe coop-vo, coop-vo/apply_vo.cpp)
notes: Since 2026-11-13 C++ (u3fix.exe coop-vo = apply_vo.py): the build equals the reference vox-mp.bin byte for byte and the 80 copied streams equal a real overlay. apply_vo.py's check compared the first 8 bytes of every old entry raw and so failed on entries that start with a pointer (87b03989), which moves with the data; the C++ check expects the moved pointer.
